findings.title: Israeli strike on a Gaza hospital kills 6 people, health authorities say
findings.location: Nasser Hospital, Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Hospital patients and medical staff; surgical wing and postoperative recovery area
findings.summary: AP now attributes at least 28 wounded to Gaza's Health Ministry, compared with the 20 wounded recorded by Reuters/WAFA in prior watches. AP quotes a volunteer surgeon that the recovery area on the surgical department's fourth floor was reduced to rubble; other floors were severely damaged. Six deaths, including surgeon Rizk Abu Shaira, are unchanged. This is an update to the same early-12-November Nasser Hospital strike, not a separate attack.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: wounded at least 28 more, Gaza’s Health Ministry said.
findings.additional_exact_supporting_passage: The recovery area on the same floor was reduced to rubble, he said.
findings.source_type: Established news reporting based on Gaza Health Ministry casualty count and firsthand volunteer surgeon eyewitness account; AP reporter observed hospital damage

bounded_discovery_context.prior_record: Six reported killed; 20 wounded in Reuters/WAFA; extensive surgical department damage at Nasser Hospital. Previous watch saw AP report without a figure of 28.

bounded_discovery_context.revision_timing: Exact AP publish/revision hour unverified; may have been available before preceding heartbeat and is recorded as retrospectively detected follow-up, not guaranteed first reported in this hour.
bounded_discovery_context.deduplication: Replace rather than add the earlier 20 injured. Do not double-count the six deceased.
